data.description:
The canonical outer live-repo guard in skill/test/scripts/run_tests.py (guarded_run_all -> shared/git_sandbox.diff_snapshots) fails an otherwise-green suite when any concurrent process moves a shared ref or registers/removes a worktree during the run. In a multi-agent repo, another agent's implement.py finish fast-forwards the main checkout's refs/heads/dev and creates/removes its own agent worktree; the guard attributes these to the tested suite and sets success=False (live_repo_mutation), blocking implement.py finish and test verification even though every test passed.

Observed repeatedly during WL-0MV4VJE8V00478ZF: suite rc=0 but the run failed with 'moved ref refs/heads/dev: <old> -> <new>' and deleted refs/config for a sibling worktree. The guard excludes refs checked out in agent worktrees (excluded_refs) but not the shared integration branch (dev) nor transient worktree registration/config, which legitimately churn under concurrency.

## Failure Signature

- Test name: tests/cli/init.test.ts > CLI Init Tests > should create semaphore when config exists but semaphore does not
- Failing commit: (not available)
- CI job: (not available)

## Evidence

- Short stderr/stdout excerpt (first 1k characters):

```
AssertionError: expected 1.0.20 to be 1.0.21 — result.version (WORKLOG_VERSION from src/version.ts = 1.0.20) does not match getPackageVersion() (package.json = 1.0.21)
```

## Root Cause

The `WORKLOG_VERSION` constant in `src/version.ts` was stale (1.0.20) while `package.json` had version 1.0.21. This caused a version mismatch in the test which reads both values and compares them. The stale value was likely in a transient `worklog-data.jsonl` file.

## Resolution

- `src/version.ts` now has `WORKLOG_VERSION = '1.0.21'` matching `package.json`
- No stale `worklog-data.jsonl` file present
- All 20 tests in `tests/cli/init.test.ts` pass
- Full test suite verified passing

## Acceptance Criteria

1. ✅ The test `tests/cli/init.test.ts > CLI Init Tests > should create semaphore when config exists but semaphore does not` passes when run against the latest `dev`.
2. ✅ No documentation changes needed — this was a transient version sync issue.
3. ✅ Full project test suite passes with the new changes.

## Summary
The herdr downtime worker's pre-dispatch CAS claim (fetcher.ts claimWorkItem, downtime-worker.ts dispatchClaimedTier) sets `--status in_progress --assignee <agent> --if-status completed --if-stage in_review` when dispatching an audit-tier item. This flips status completed->in_progress but **leaves the stage at in_review**, creating the hybrid `in-progress`/`in_review` pair.

## Observed (RISE-0MV5SE6SZ00794RO audit, 2026-10-14)
Implementation correctly left the item at completed/in_review. The herdr worker claimed it at 06:35:12.307Z (24ms before the dispatch comment), producing in-progress/in_review. The audit runner (invoked --force due to pre-flight guard) captured that hybrid as its pre-audit state. Phase 2 timed out; the failure-restore path restored the captured (in-progress, in_review), which its own inlined _STATUS_STAGE_COMPAT (audit_runner.py:11896 maps in-progress -> {intake_complete, plan_complete}) rejects as invalid and coerced to in-progress/plan_complete — stranding the item one step down from completed/in_review. Manual fix restored completed/in_review.

## Root cause chain
1. TIER_EXPECTED.audit = { status: 'completed', stage: 'in_review' } is the CAS guard, but the claim ALWAYS sets --status in_progress and never migrates the stage for the non-retired path.
2. The worklog status-stage validator (dist/status-stage-validation.js:36) explicitly allows in-progress/in_review as a 'transitional' exception (RISK documented: interrupted audits leave the item hybrid).
3. The audit runner's inlined _STATUS_STAGE_COMPAT table does NOT include that exception, so its failure-restore coercion demotes in_review -> plan_complete.

## Fix options
- A (herdr): audit-tier claim should keep the item at completed/in_review (only CAS-guard, no status flip) or migrate stage consistently, OR
- B (audit_runner): _STATUS_STAGE_COMPAT should include the in-progress/in_review transitional pair so failure-restore keeps in_review for review-queue items.
- Also: dispatch-failure rollback path (rollbackClaimForFailure) already restores 'completed'/'in_review' for audit (line 3066) — the spawn-success path has no post-audit claim-cleanup; the audit runner's own lifecycle is expected to manage it but the coercion defeats it.

## Consequences
- Repeated pattern: every herdr auto-dispatched audit of a completed/in_review item pre-flight-guards (needs --force) and, on infra-failure (Phase 2 timeout), can strand the item at in-progress/plan_complete — off the review queue and out of the audit tier's selection (which needs completed/in_review).
- NeedsProducerReview was not set; the item is now manually corrected.

Related: WL-0MTYL7DX9000MZOH (retired-stage claim), WL-0MSRBFFLN005W3VT (CAS claim RCA), SA-0MSL1Z1WU005O5IY (pre-flight guard), WL-0MUWKGW9W004QXQZ (claim skip for done).
data.title: Herdr downtime audit claim leaves item in-progress/in_review (invalid combo); failed audit coerces to in-progress/plan_complete instead of completed/in_review
